title: Pugliese et al. (bioRxiv v1; Nature 2026 doi 10.1038/s41586-026-11195-y)
source_locator: bioRxiv v1 Fig. 2h-k; Methods (optogenetic activation); Supplementary Video 1
quote: DNg100 activation produced forward walking on the ball, but at a lower speed than is typical of wild-type flies
mapping_basis: Paper uses the MANC/Namiki type name DNg100, which is a type in type_list.csv.
stimulation: 638 nm laser focused at body-coxa joint of front left leg, 1200 Hz, 30% duty cycle; 0.03, 0.09, 0.33 mW/mm2 (strongest 0.33); 5 s stim-on per 15 s trial
sensory_condition: decapitated, de-winged, tethered on air-supported spherical treadmill
frequency_note: Fig. 2k: stepping frequency of left front leg increased with laser intensity; no experimental Hz values found in text.
coordination_notes: Methods: flies generally exhibited a tetrapod coordination pattern
n_flies_note: n=7 flies, 8 trials per fly (Fig. 2j legend)
notes: Split-GAL4 line labeling DNg100 cited ([47]) but line ID not given in text read. Walking -> yes for all leg pairs per convention. Forward velocity increased with intensity. saw_simulation_score true: while reading I saw a statement that simulated oscillations matched real stepping frequency (~7-15 Hz), in the DNg100 context; no numeric per-type score was read.

title: Pugliese et al. (bioRxiv v1; Nature 2026 doi 10.1038/s41586-026-11195-y)
quote: Activating DNb08 produced oscillatory movement of the front and middle legs
mapping_basis: Paper uses the MANC/Namiki type name DNb08; driver_lines.csv also lists SS70620 as DNb08 (Confident).
stimulation: 638 nm laser focused on front left leg body-coxa joint, 1200 Hz 30% duty cycle; intensity for DNb08 not stated; 8 stim-on and 4 stim-off trials per fly
sensory_condition: decapitated, tethered; spherical treadmill removed (legs not in contact with substrate)
coordination_notes: Not coordinated walking; resembled searching/flailing movements; femur-tibia joint kinematics of front and middle legs
penetrance: Front leg p=0.036, middle leg p=0.004 (paired t-test, stim-on vs stim-off)
n_flies_note: n=10 flies, 8 stim-on and 4 stim-off trials per fly
notes: Text: 'DNb08 evoked leg movements more reliably when the spherical treadmill was removed' and legs 'not in contact with the substrate', so surface coded air. Sex taken from general Methods (female). Hind legs not measured. line_specificity 'clean' based on kit (no off-target listed); paper did not state specificity in text I read. Confidence medium because oscillation amplitude/cycle count (>=3 cycles) not directly verified from video.
